text:
Adam Lowry has played 869 games for the Jets, all of them, and he is still the player he has always been: a big checking center, 53 hits, nine points in 24 games. His goals sit right on his chances, and Winnipeg is about even on five-on-five expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), at 47% on a team that is 47% overall.

Evolving-Hockey had him right at replacement level last season, which says more about what models can measure than about what a checking center is for. Our numbers can't see all of it either. What they can see is that the Jets are not losing ground with him out there, which is the job. A third-round pick out of Swift Current in 2011, he has never played anywhere else. Our range has him around 10 goals.
